note: Words that do NOT count as extra words when an existence-only citation answer compares a case title with the cited parties: Indian state and union-territory names (a citation says 'State of M.P.', the title spells 'Madhya Pradesh'), corporate and party-status suffix words, and similar. Never add a word that can tell two different cases apart (an entity word such as 'industries' or 'enterprises', or a person's name). Tokens are lower-case ASCII; the loader folds them as it folds titles. A missing or unreadable file means an empty list (the strict rule). A change needs a re-measure on a sample of resolvable citations, a hand-check of every newly accepted answer, and a slim-index versus full-index comparison with no difference.
